subject: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps (SOC 2, pen test, audit logs)
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finexa.com>, Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps (SOC 2, pen test, audit logs)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear breakdown of how Redwood would fit into our inference stack. A couple of ask follow-ups from my side as we map this internally: 

1) Can you confirm whether you can share a SOC 2 Type II report and a concise summary of your most recent penetration test? We need to hand both to procurement/security.
2) Our security team would like a small sample of audit logs (redacted) to validate retention and access controls — is that something you can provide?
3) Who should we loop in on the Redwood side for a short technical Q&A with our infra/security folks (30 minutes)?

Our expected procurement timeline is 4–6 weeks once security signoff is complete.

Best,
Alice
Head of Cloud Ops | Finexa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps (SOC 2, pen test, audit logs)

Alice —

Great to talk earlier. Thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and next actions.

1) SOC 2: We can share a SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. For initial review, I attached a redacted stub of our SOC 2 report (SOC2_Type2_Finexa_Redwood_stub.pdf) and a short SOC2 FAQ. If you need the full report, we can run the NDAs and share the complete file.
2) Pen test: We have a high-level pen test summary from 2025 we can share (summary attached). For detailed vuln reports we typically share via secure portal after an access request.
3) Audit logs: I'm including a CSV sample of audit logs (redacted) that shows retention metadata, event types, and access principal.

Technical Q&A: looping in Dev (our lead sales engineer) and Marissa (CS/security partner) — either of them can join a 30-minute session. Proposed slots: Tue 5/12 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 5/13 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works?

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the internal reviewers (security/procurement/finance) and preferred slot.
- We execute an NDA if you want the full SOC 2 doc.
- Run the 30-minute tech Q&A to close any open infra questions.

Thanks — I'll also log these artifacts in the HubSpot deal.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finexa.com>, Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@finexa.com>, Peter Huang <p.huang@procure-finexa.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps (SOC 2, pen test, audit logs)

Ben/Team —

Thanks for the materials. Quick procurement notes from our side:
- We'll need the SOC 2 uploaded to our secure procurement portal (I can provide an upload link) under vendor>security>evidence.
- Our legal will want a summary of data retention controls for inference logs and whether Redwood supports deletion-on-demand for datasets and model inputs.
- Any standard template for Subprocessor and Data Processing Agreement language would speed our review.

Can Marissa or Dev confirm Redwood's retention defaults and whether deletion APIs exist? Also confirm who our contact will be for the contract redlines.

Regards,
Tom Reyes
Senior Procurement Manager | Finexa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finexa.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps (SOC 2, pen test, audit logs)

Hi Tom/Alice —

Looping in David (Head of Security Partnerships) and Dev (SE) to address the technical retention and DPA questions. Short answers to start:

- Retention: Default audit-log retention is 90 days for service logs and 365 days for customer-requested audit exports. We can configure longer retention under Dedicated/Private plans.
- Deletion: Yes — we provide a deletion API for customer-managed datasets and have deletion workflows for request/incident response. We also maintain an immutable audit trail of admin actions (not the dataset payloads) for compliance.
- Subprocessor/DPA: We have standard DPA language; I attached a DPA checklist and link to the legal template in the deal record. For redlines, Ben can own commercial points and our legal team will review DPA redlines.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tom — please send the procurement upload link and list of docs needed.
2) We schedule the 30-minute technical Q&A (Dev + David + Finexa infra/security). Proposed slot: Wed 5/13 14:00 PT.
3) If you want the full SOC 2, reply and Ben will route the NDA.

- Marissa
Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
